correctness.rationale: For every 0<=a<b<c, contracting the c-matching gives a d-step path forest under the b-edges. The a-edges contract to arcs i->i+(b-a) mod d, whose g gcd-orbits yield exactly max(0,a+1-d+g) independent cycles, including the loop and parallel cases. A fresh-sum matching t>2m adds only leaves or isolated edges and hence extends every acyclic triple to an infinite acyclic support. The externally cited incidence-forest equivalence gives the full initial-three-word existence classification. A standalone disjoint-set checker verified 14,190 triples and 2,505 continuation stages, not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Three is the first nontrivial number of marked positions because unions of one or two sum matchings are forests. The theorem gives a complete and usable gcd formula for every possible first-three sparse-letter location in an extremal word, including sufficiency by infinite continuation, and quantifies cycle-rank obstructions outside the permissible range. The exact condition captures failures beyond the classic three-term arithmetic progression/Sidon obstruction and beyond sufficient doubling-growth tests. It is a motivated structural boundary and not a mere numerical table.
